title: A regenerable redox mediator for all-air processed wide-bandgap perovskite solar cells under high-humidity conditions
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, 19,189-199
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE05252A, Paper
Yuting Song, Xinhang Cai, Haoyu Ge, Xuelian Liu, Ziyan Liu, Aijun Li, Naoyuki Shibayama, Xiao-Feng Wang
We introduce 4-mercaptophenylacetic acid into a perovskite precursor and fabricate devices in ambient air (65% RH), achieving a PCE of 23.16%.
